newsitem.title: USA: Rubin indicates no change in US dollar policy.
newsitem.headline: Rubin indicates no change in US dollar policy.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Wednesday he has stated the U.S. position on the dollar in recent days, and he did not add anything further.
"So let me just say that I stated our policy position and I have nothing to add to the statement," Rubin told reporters after testifying at a congressional hearing.
Rubin last week said a strong dollar is in the U.S. interest and added "we've had a strong dollar for some time."
That comment was interpreted as a sign that the Treasury secretary would not be unhappy with some weakening of the dollar.
Rubin Wednesday would not comment on the interpretation of his dollar statement.
